description: Source code for nsRemoteDebuggingPipe class implementing inter-thread communication and platform-specific socket handling for remote debugging in Mozilla Firefox.

classes.name: nsRemoteDebuggingPipe
classes.description: Implements a platform-specific pipe for remote debugging communication, supporting message sending and receiving, threading, and cleanup.

methods.name: GetSingleton
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of nsRemoteDebuggingPipe.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the pipe with a client, sets up threads, and platform-specific handles.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the pipe, cleans up resources, and shuts down threads.

methods.name: SendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message through the pipe to the client.
